title: Third-Man Run (Combination Play)
content: The third-man run is a three-player combination where player A passes to player B, and player C — the third man — arrives into space to receive a lay-off from B. The key is that player C's movement begins before the ball reaches B, so when B receives and turns, C is already arriving at pace into space behind the defensive line. This movement is extremely difficult to defend because the defensive line cannot track a runner who starts their run from outside their visual field. The combination requires excellent timing and spatial awareness: C must read when A will play to B, begin the run at the right moment, and arrive as B lays off. The third-man movement is most devastating when C is arriving from deep, generating pace into the channel.
